Types

FastProxyHostValidation = enum
  hostPublic,               ## hostPrivate: the host name or a resolved address is private/internal.
  hostPrivate, ## hostResolutionFailed: the DNS lookup failed (NXDOMAIN, SERVFAIL,
                ## resolver unreachable, ...). This is distinct from hostPrivate so
                ## callers can answer 502 instead of 403 when DNS itself is down.
  hostResolutionFailed
hostPublic: the host is a public IP literal or all resolved addresses are public. 
FastProxyOptions = object
  target*: string
  targetResolver*: FastProxyTargetResolver
  timeoutMs*: int            ## Upper bound for the upstream request. Defaults to 30s.
  connectTimeoutMs*: int     ## Upper bound for the upstream TCP connect. Defaults to 5s.
  stripPrefix*: string
  pathRewriter*: FastProxyPathRewriter
  preserveHostHeader*: bool
  addXForwardedHeaders*: bool
  blockPrivateUpstreams*: bool ## Block requests to private/internal IP addresses (RFC 1918, link-local,
                               ## loopback, CGNAT). Enabled by default to match proxy(). To disable
                               ## blocking, set allowPrivateUpstreams, or set this field to false
                               ## together with blockPrivateUpstreamsExplicit.
  blockPrivateUpstreamsExplicit*: bool ## Marks blockPrivateUpstreams as user-provided. When false (the
                                       ## default), normalizeFastProxyOptions forces blockPrivateUpstreams to
                                       ## true unless allowPrivateUpstreams is set, so a bare object literal
                                       ## cannot accidentally disable SSRF protection.
  allowPrivateUpstreams*: bool ## Explicitly permit private/internal upstreams for trusted local
                               ## deployments. Takes precedence over blockPrivateUpstreams.
  allowUnpinnedDnsUpstreams*: bool ## Permit hostname upstreams when blockPrivateUpstreams is enabled. This
                                   ## preserves legacy behavior but cannot prevent DNS rebinding unless the
                                   ## underlying client pins the validated address.
  maxRequestBytes*: int ## Maximum request body bytes forwarded upstream. Non-positive values use
                        ## DefaultFastProxyMaxRequestBytes.
  maxResponseBytes*: int ## Maximum upstream response body bytes sent downstream. Non-positive
                         ## values use DefaultFastProxyMaxResponseBytes.
  client*: ptr fasttypes.HttpClient
  loop*: UsLoopPtr
FastProxyPathRewriter = proc (path: string): string {.closure.}
FastProxyTargetResolver = proc (req: Req): string {.closure.}

Forward requests to a fixed upstream target.

The returned middleware owns its client for the process lifetime; the client is allocated with raw memory and is intentionally never deallocated. Create one middleware per upstream and keep it for the life of the process; do not create and discard it repeatedly.
